find: return { format: DIAGNOSTICS_FORMAT, schema: DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA, ...diagnosticsReport(input), round };
replace: return { format: DIAGNOSTICS_FORMAT, schema: DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA, round } as DiagnosticsFile;
killedBy: diagnosticsExport saves Copy Diagnostics' own record, stamped, plus the round
the exports (issue #254) Download Diagnostics saves one JSON file of the live session and round, and says so
why: The diagnostics file keeps its stamp and round but loses every field Copy Diagnostics prints: URL, build, session, flags, notes and unknown parameters. Issue #254 requires the file to 'match Copy Diagnostics fields', and a file without them still saves, still parses and still carries a plausible name, so nothing but a field-for-field comparison notices.
